tasks.title: Receipt, API boundary and ingestion security tests
Pipeline, evidence kernel, monitoring, 36-month manifest tests
Open-source registry review and honesty tests

defects.title: Pipeline summary and receipt read non-existent key 'summary'; reconciliation_summary was always {} and the receipt did not commit to exposure totals
Substring match of source_record_id in finding subject let unrelated documents (e.g. 'I1' vs 'I10') corroborate and qualify a finding
Admission accepted any media type (HTML, PDF, binary, malformed JSON) as ADMITTED; non-object JSON crashed with AttributeError (HTTP 500)
Replay overwrote the 'immutable' envelope (new ingested_at) before raising; conflicting content for the same source record was silently accepted
Monitoring labelled itself ActorKind.HUMAN; audit log had no hash chain so deletion/reordering was undetectable
POST /pipeline/audit returned 500 for an invalid snapshot instead of 400

limitations.title: Payment applied to the wrong invoice is reported as OVERPAYMENT + PARTIAL_PAYMENT (both UNVERIFIED), not netted into one economic event
Evidence-root independence is per (source_system, source_record_id); two records from one ERP count as independent roots
Contract supersession invalidates every RATE finding because findings carry no contract id (fails closed, over-invalidates)

Pipeline/monitoring state is in memory: no persistence, no restart recovery; /pipeline/ingest builds a fresh engine per request so replay protection does not span requests; /pipeline/audit results are not persisted or MAC-sealed
Equipment-hour and personnel-hour reconciliation, and payment reversals, are not implemented (negative payments are rejected)
PaddleOCR digest in registry/code is the SHA-256 of empty input; OCR, PDF, image and XLSX ingestion are NOT_VERIFIED and refused
